ctx.x: 5327 Dauphine Street. And this place was 816 Andrew what I'm talking about. The backyard gave to the backyard. You know I mean close enough to take the, the exodus that was going on.
Did you know Rene Baptiste and that bass player? Rene Baptiste, I know his name but I don't know him.
